audit: H emphasis convention audit of gated consolidated records, scans002–007 only
model: GPT-6 Astra Pro, inherited configuration; effort setting not exposed
scope: Read-only review of records/scan002.json through scan007.json, their emphasis-related decisions, and already-gated H pages1–6. No manuscript images, other-reader reports, scan008 main record, or scan009 material opened for this audit.

documentary_sources.finding: normalem preserves ordinary emph behavior; comment says transcriptions use emph for Grothendieck’s own emphasis. No explicit mapping to physical manuscript underlining is supplied.
uncertain is rendered with uline; rendered underlining can be the transcriber’s doubt marker.
Entire supplied short guide read. It has no emph/underlining mapping; lines18–20 identify the tex as source of record.
Actual emph occurrences and notes about underlining were compared with the consolidated decision descriptions.

rule: Same-span emph-to-uline authorial emphasis conversion alone is not a substantive difference. Keep actual span, number of ink rules, word, insertion/deletion and omission differences separately. Do not treat uncertain-underlining as authorial emphasis.
conclusion: No existing counted decision in scans002–007 is solely a same-span emph-to-uline/uuline conversion. No automatic diff_H=false change is recommended on that ground.

recommended_action.evidence_correction: H already marks fine with emph. The surviving difference is its unmarked intersection; do not count the emph-to-uline treatment of fine.

findings.reason: H line149 reads intersection \emph{fine}. The final marks both words.

findings.classification: cancelled text omitted; state already acknowledged in H

recommended_action.evidence_correction: H line164 explicitly describes the old word as underlined and struck. The difference here is the final tentative literal reading éléments and its explicit rendering, not H giving a deleted word live.

findings.reason: The present deletion-state category overstates the disagreement in source state.

findings.classification: combined insertion/punctuation/drawing difference with inaccurate H emphasis gloss

recommended_action.H_correction: \emph{lieux} followed by colon; editorial note places it above an underlined, cancelled old word and describes the connector
recommended_action.evidence_correction: Do not say H explicitly underlines the live lieux. Its emph marks authorial emphasis. Retain the independently recorded insertion, punctuation and drawn-connector differences.

findings.reason: H does not confuse the old word’s underlining with the replacement in its editorial note.

findings.classification: plain-final versus H authorial-emphasis marker; no explicit H underline

recommended_action.diff_H: no automatic change from this audit
recommended_action.evidence_correction: The ink/final record has no baseline underline. H marks the heading as authorial emphasis with emph; the supplied convention does not say this asserts a physical underline.

findings.reason: This is not the same-span emph-to-uline conversion posed by the audit because the final is plain. It cannot be labelled an invented underline or invented text on the documentary evidence alone. Any inclusion in a physical-ink error count requires a separate rationale.

findings.classification: plain-final versus H authorial-emphasis marker; no explicit H underline

recommended_action.diff_H: no automatic change from this audit
recommended_action.evidence_correction: No baseline rule is recorded beneath Notation. H’s emph marks authorial emphasis, without specifying a physical underline.

findings.reason: As with 005-46, do not convert a typographic emphasis marker into a claim that H transcribed an extra underline.

findings.classification: exact underline spans absent in markup but acknowledged generally in H note

recommended_action.diff_H: retain only as exact-span/placement distinction, not total omission
recommended_action.H_correction: Marginal body text is plain; H line260 explicitly states that the marginal notes are underlined, without identifying the specific word spans.
recommended_action.evidence_correction: The final identifies compatibility/par strates and raffinement/par strates/Corollaire as separate marked spans. H’s general acknowledgement must be mentioned rather than saying it omits emphasis entirely.

findings.reason: H line260 uses sont soulignées for these marginal notes.

recommended_action.evidence_correction: Retain the spelling difference déployement/déploiement and the unmarked strates occurrences. Do not count an emphasis omission on déploiement itself.

findings.reason: H expressly emphasizes déploiement on line166.

recommended_action.evidence_correction: The final underline excludes Critère; H’s emphasized argument includes it. This is a span difference in addition to the independently recorded word and punctuation differences.

findings.reason: An emphasis conversion over the shared words is not an additional difference.

number_of_lines: No current decision among these six consolidated records explicitly turns only on single versus double underline or uline versus uuline. No underline multiplicity is inferred from emph, and no earlier superseded reader judgment is substituted for the gated record.
modifications: Only readers/R1/emphasis_audit.json and emphasis_audit.md were written; consolidated records and TeX were not changed.
